journeys: J1 documented happy path set-theme dark -> view (FAILED, F-001)

findings.observed: python app/app.py set-theme dark prints 'Saved OK' and theme.cfg verifiably contains 'dark'; python app/app.py view then prints 'rendering notes page with theme: light'. Reproduced 5/5 times including after cfg delete/recreate cycle. view does not rewrite the file (cfg stays 'dark').
findings.expected_basis: README: 'python app.py view renders the notes page with the saved theme applied'; packet purpose: 'A user can set the theme and the view applies it'. Save side works; view side never applies the persisted dark value.
findings.reproduction: evidence/repro-all-findings.ps1 block F-001: set-theme dark; Get-Content app/theme.cfg (=dark); view (=light)

findings.observed: set-theme blue, set-theme DARK, set-theme Dark, and bare set-theme each print 'Saved OK' with exit 0. Persisted values verified raw in theme.cfg: 'blue', 'DARK', 'Dark'; bare set-theme persists 'light'. Contrast: set-theme dark extra is rejected by the parser ('unrecognized arguments: extra', exit 2).
findings.expected_basis: README documents the value domain as <light|dark>; the product's own parser rejects invalid arg counts strictly, so silent acceptance of invalid/missing values with a success message is an internal contradiction and false user feedback.

findings.observed: python app/app.py --help fails with 'app.py: error: unrecognized arguments: --help', exit 2 (reproduced twice). Help content exists only as the usage line on no-args/unknown-command, which also advertises an undocumented --smoke flag.
findings.expected_basis: CLI convention and the product's own usage string 'usage: app.py [--smoke] [cmd] [arg]' imply a discoverable help surface; a first-time user's standard --help attempt errors instead.

findings.observed: Unknown command ('bogus-command') and no-args print the usage line but exit 0, while parser-level errors (--help, extra args) exit 2.
findings.expected_basis: Internal inconsistency with the product's own exit-code behavior elsewhere (exit 2 on argparse errors); callers cannot reliably detect failure on error paths.

capability_gaps: Notes-page content beyond the 'theme: <x>' status line is not verifiable: no public surface creates notes and the packet provides no test data; the render output observed is a single status line only
